summary: Font handling throughout Firefox was significantly modernized through extensive Skrifa integration: the Rust font library now handles metrics calculation, glyph details, font tables, face names, and font variations, replacing older C++ implementations across Windows, macOS, and Linux. CSS `font-width` replaced `font-stretch` as the modern property name (with the old name as an alias), and the browser improved font table validation, added Sans Serif Collection support for Windows systems, and removed legacy feature flags for font variations and color palettes that are now universally supported.
